English: Skinning Rack
A set of crude wooden frames for skinning and drying animal pelts, set up at the edge of the camp.
Basic Fur Tent
A simple tent of stitched hides, protecting furs and workers from the elements.
Tanning Shelter
A semi-permanent hide-covered structure, with pits and troughs for curing pelts and minimizing waste.
Cured Hide Depot
A fortified, mobile storehouse for stacks of treated furs and hides, guarded by trusted clansmen.
Furriers Pavilion
A large, decorated tent serving as the headquarters for skilled furriers and their apprentices, handling trade and luxury commissions.
Embellished Tannery
A robust, semi-permanent tannery with decorative elements, renowned for producing high-quality pelts for trade and noble use.
Specialist Trappers Yurt
A dedicated yurt for master trappers, complete with advanced equipment and space for training new furriers.
Luxury Fur Cabin
A lavish, portable wooden cabin lined with the finest pelts, serving as a gathering place for chieftains and wealthy traders.
Steppe Fur Market
A bustling seasonal market, attracting distant merchants and boosting the local economy through the fur trade.
Royal Furriers' Guild
A prestigious institution controlling all major fur production and trade, closely associated with the khans court and foreign emissaries.
